safety.reason: Freeze CoreA/CoreB/MEDIUM policy for reproducible audit before any demo/runtime connection.

coreA.name: CoreA_fold4_ABC_CAP5
coreA.definition: fold4_rules + ABC entry gate + CAP5 sizing

coreB.name: RR125_BUY_CONFLUENCE
coreB.definition: RR1.0-derived BUY rules re-evaluated with TP = 1.25 * SL; same_count >= 15; CAP3 sizing

confluence.name: CoreA_BUY_plus_CoreB_BUY_same_entry_time
confluence.condition: same entry_time and same direction BUY
confluence.initial_effective_lot_description: CoreA 1.0 + extra CoreB 0.5 = 1.5 equivalent when CoreA BUY and CoreB BUY overlap exactly.
confluence.conflict_rule: If CoreA SELL conflicts with CoreB BUY at the exact same entry_time, CoreA has priority and CoreB is skipped until a separate conflict audit approves otherwise.

medium.precedence_rule: CoreA/CoreB > MEDIUM. Skip MEDIUM when it shares entry_time with any CoreA/CoreB signal. If multiple MEDIUM signals share entry_time + direction, keep the first by priority.

RANGE96_REFINED.definition: CoreA REJECT add-on: range96 >= 129.6835 AND trend_eff96 <= 0.355591 AND top_direction == SELL; CAP3

VOL_TRMEAN32_REFINED.definition: CoreA REJECT add-on: tr_mean_32 >= 10.867578 AND ret96 <= -2.725 AND range96 >= 176.453; CAP3

TIER2_HVT.definition: CoreA REJECT add-on: Tier2 static plus HIGH_VOL_TREND; CAP3

ORIGIN010_REFINED.definition: CoreA REJECT add-on: top_candidate_id == GOLDV2_ORIGIN_010 AND range96 >= 41.99 AND same_direction_count <= 9; CAP3
ORIGIN010_REFINED.reason: Improved by filtering but kept out of default MEDIUM because 2025 drawdown was heavier and it is less clean than RANGE96/VOL/TIER2_HVT.
